content.description: We are here to take your native currency from all over the world to it's limit by converting it to Puzzle tokens and taking that to your marketplace of choice. The ultimate goal of Puzzle is to create an asset that not only holds value against inflation and negative government activities all over the world, but has steady increases in value.
